age.evidence: Nine Sprague Dawley male adult rats

sex.evidence: Nine Sprague Dawley male adult rats were maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle

dosing.doses_raw: noribogaine 20 mg/kg (N20, six rats), noribogaine 40 mg/kg (N40, seven rats)
dosing.evidence: rats either received noribogaine 20 mg/kg (N 20 , six rats), noribogaine 40 mg/kg (N 40 , seven rats), or saline solution (Control, nine rats) i.p.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages (40 × 30 × 20 cm)

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 06.00 AM). Experimental sessions were conducted during the light period, between 11 AM and 5 PM

enrichment_housing.evidence: transparent cages (40 × 30 × 20 cm) containing wood shaving material

assays.assay_description: 6-hour continuous EEG (M1, S1) + EMG recording in a sound-attenuated chamber, with rats freely moving in their transparent home-cage-style recording box. Sleep-wake states (W, LS, SWS, REM) scored in 10-s epochs; total time, episode number, episode duration, and latencies analyzed.

application_type.evidence: animals were injected with a noribogaine dose or vehicle i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: At the end of the surgical procedures, they were adapted to the recording chamber for at least 4 days.

setup_restrain.evidence: The recordings were performed through a rotating commutator, to allow the rats to freely move within the recording box.

food_restriction.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages ... with water and food ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: with water and food ad libitum

time_to_assay.evidence: Before the beginning of the recordings, animals were injected with a noribogaine dose or vehicle i.p.

outcomes.summary: Acute i.p. noribogaine (20 and 40 mg/kg) increased wakefulness and decreased slow-wave sleep over a 6-hour recording, while persistently suppressing REM sleep (reduced total REM, fewer REM episodes, and markedly delayed REM latency). Effects peaked in the first 2 h and were dose-dependent, with REM suppression lasting through the entire recording at the high dose.
outcomes.evidence: both noribogaine doses significantly promoted W ... while significantly reducing SWS ... and REM ... REM latency significantly increased for both doses

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total time spent in W, LS, SWS, and REM sleep, as well as the duration and number of episodes ... Sleep latencies were also evaluated.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: we divided our recordings into three blocks of 2 h ... peak effects for both doses occurred within the first 2 h

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions/sequences between states reported beyond episode counts/durations.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only EEG/EMG-defined sleep-wake states scored; no natural behaviours measured.

B5_social.evidence: Animals were housed individually and recorded alone.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Polysomnographic recording, no learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The states of sleep and wakefulness were determined in 10-s epochs following the criteria previously employed by our group (manual scoring).

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate ANOVAs on separate measures; no PCA/clustering reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages (40 × 30 × 20 cm) containing wood shaving material ... Experimental sessions were conducted ... in a sound-attenuated chamber

E2_shelter.evidence: Transparent cage with wood shavings; no enclosed refuge described.

E3_bedding.evidence: transparent cages (40 × 30 × 20 cm) containing wood shaving material

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material mentioned in the testing cage.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in the recording cage.

E8_food_water.evidence: with water and food ad libitum

D1_continuity.evidence: we recorded animals during 6 h following i.p. administration

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single 6-h recording session per treatment; cross-over animals contribute separate days per condition but each assay condition is one recording day.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline recording in the same assay; saline control was a separate session/group.

D5_followup.evidence: Recordings ended within 6 h of administration; no ≥24 h follow-up.

D6_circadian.evidence: 6-hour session does not exceed 6 h threshold.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (polysomnographic sleep-wake recording) is present; qwen and gptoss returned empty assay lists, glm provided the assay scoring which was used as the base and verified against the paper.
B1 upgraded to 7+ because the paper reports total time, number of episodes, and episode duration for each of 4 states plus latencies (>7 distinct measures).
DOI reconstructed as 10.1007/s00213-024-06572-2 from supplementary link in paper.
n_total set to 22 (sum across groups: 9+6+7); n_male=22 since all subjects were male.
D3 set to 1: each treatment condition was a single 6-h recording; cross-over design uses different days for different conditions but per-condition is a single recording day for the assay.
D4 set to No: saline control was a separate session/animal-condition, not a pre-drug baseline within the same recording.
Enrichment_housing set to 'no' since wood shavings (bedding) are the only home-cage feature mentioned; no enrichment items reported.
